jobs.description:
About Alia

Alia is an e-commerce popup and list-growth platform used by more than 4,500 merchants, from emerging DTC brands to household names like AG1, HexClad, and Dollar Shave Club. Our products, including Smart Triggering, Smart Offers, Smart Testing, Smart Timing, and Prism AI, help brands convert more visitors into subscribers and customers. Alia was founded without outside funding, grew to $13M ARR, and was acquired by Dotdigital in March 2026.

The Role

We are launching a new product line that extends what Alia does for e-commerce brands. The product line will sit in the ads, media buying, and data space, and it is still at the earliest stage. There is no existing product, roadmap, or defined scope yet, so you will shape what it becomes from the ground up.

This role owns the product line from zero to one. You will define what we build, validate it with merchants, ship the first version, and grow it into a meaningful part of the business. You will have access to more than 4,500 merchants, a Customer Success team that knows them well, and the distribution of Dotdigital's broader platform.

This is one of Alia's first two product management hires. There is no product operations team and no established product process. You will help build the product function from the ground up, including how we plan, prioritize, write requirements, and measure results. If you want a mature product organization with defined rituals, this is not the right role. If you want to shape how product works at a fast-growing company, it is.

You will report directly to our Chief Customer Officer. That gives you close access to our largest customers, the teams that serve them, and company leadership.

What You Will Do

Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the new product line, from initial concept through launch and scale.
Lead customer discovery with merchants across segments to validate the problem, the solution, and willingness to pay.
Define the first version, set launch criteria, and make clear scope tradeoffs to get product into merchants' hands quickly.
Establish and own the success metrics for the product line, including adoption, activation, retention, and revenue, and report on them to leadership.
Partner with Marketing and Revenue on positioning, pricing, packaging, and go-to-market for launch.
Work with Customer Success, Support, and Onboarding to design how merchants adopt and are supported on the new product, and use their feedback to drive iteration.
Write clear product requirements and work with Engineering and Design from discovery through launch.
Determine how the new product line connects to Alia's existing products and to Dotdigital's platform.
Help define how product management works at Alia, including planning, prioritization, and requirements processes.

What We Are Looking For

6+ years of product management experience in B2B eCommerce SaaS. Specifically, in the ads, media buying, and data/personalization verticals.
Experience as an early PM at a startup or launching a new product inside an established company.
Experience taking a new product from zero to one, including discovery, first version definition, launch, and early growth.
A track record of shipping products that generated measurable adoption and revenue.
Strong commercial judgment, with hands-on experience in pricing, packaging, or go-to-market.
Strong analytical skills. You are comfortable pulling your own data, defining metrics, and building a case with numbers.
The ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information and to change course quickly when the data says so.
The ability to work across functions and earn trust with Engineering, Design, and customer-facing teams.
Comfort operating without established process, and the judgment to build only as much process as the team needs.
Clear, direct written and verbal communication.

What We Offer

$192,000 USD base salary plus $40,000 target bonus
Full benefits coverage: medical, dental, and vision
401(k)
Unlimited PTO
Flexibility to work remotely or from our NYC office
Ownership of a new product line from concept to scale
A founding role in Alia's product function
The pace and ownership of a founder-led team, backed by the resources of Dotdigital

VP of Product - Software

Hybrid / Remote · HQ Allentown, PA · Seed Stage

About 4MP

At 4MP, we are building a new technological foundation for precision manufacturing. Our systems enable CNC machines to self-measure, self-correct, and continuously improve their performance - transforming conventional machine tools into
autonomous precision systems.
Backed by a leading institutional investor and extensively vetted by recognized experts across industry and government laboratories, 4MP is at the beginning of a category-defining journey. We are transitioning from early development into building a visionary company that will redefine how precision manufacturing is done globally.

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on VP of Software who has built and shipped industrial software that runs in production, on real machines, in real plants. You will build and lead the software organization and the product it delivers, from architecture through release, working directly with the founding leadership team and R&D team across machine physics, metrology, AI, and customer operations to turn our technology into a reliable, deployable, commercial product.

Joining at this seed stage means you will have a foundational voice in shaping the company, the product architecture, and how we deliver software to manufacturing customers. You will not simply manage a backlog; you will define what we ship, how we ship it, and the standard of quality we hold ourselves to.

What You Will Do

Own the Software Product:
Define and drive the product strategy, roadmap, and release plan, and be accountable for what reaches customers. You will lead the software and product function while staying technically hands-on in architecture, code, and design reviews.
Ship Production-Grade Software:
Turn research and prototypes created by the R&D team into a hardened, supportable product with real release discipline: versioning, testing, documentation, deployment, upgrades, and field support.
 Define the SaaS and Deployment Model:
Architect how the platform is delivered and licensed across cloud, on-premise, edge, and disconnected plant networks, with the telemetry and update paths each demands.
Own Industrial Requirements and Security:
Drive requirements for cybersecurity, data protection, access control, uptime, traceability, and validation, aligned to industrial and customer IT standards.
Run the Development Process:
Establish the operating cadence of the engineering organization: agile planning, sprint execution, definition of done, release trains, and honest schedule management.
Lead Customer Deployments and Pilots:
Work directly with customers on requirements, pilot installations, and production rollout, and convert what you learn on the floor into product decisions.
Drive Strategic Cross-Functional Leadership:
In close interaction with other functional leaders, you will contribute to defining the company strategy, technology and business roadmaps, and comprehensive project plans.

What We Require

Proven Industrial Software Delivery:
A solid track record of building and shipping commercial software used in manufacturing, robotics, industrial automation, or comparable industrial environments. You have owned products that customers run every day.
10+ Years of Experience:
Deep background in software engineering and product leadership, including time spent building software yourself before leading others who build it.
Real-World Sensing and Machine Data:
Direct experience with products built on sensor, metrology, control, or telemetry data from physical systems, and a clear understanding of how messy that data is in practice.
Industrial Requirements and Security:
Working knowledge of industrial cybersecurity, on-premise and segmented plant networks, safety and quality expectations, data governance, and the validation and documentation that industrial customers require.
SaaS and Platform Product Leadership:
Experience defining and running a software-as-a-service or platform product, including architecture tradeoffs, release management, support models, and commercial packaging.
Software Team Leadership:
Proven ability to lead engineers and product managers, set priorities under real constraints, and hold a team to a shipping schedule without losing technical credibility.
Educational Foundation:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field.

What Will Set You Apart

Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the new product line, from initial concept through launch and scale.
Lead customer discovery with merchants across segments to validate the problem, the solution, and willingness to pay.

This role is pivotal in shaping how people managing chronic disease engage with digital tools that support their care—driving core KPIs via customer-centric design and product excellence. As a product leader, you will define and lead the strategies and roadmaps for consumer companion apps designed to improve health outcomes and build lasting consumer trust. Technical Collaboration and Standards

Collaborate with Business Analysts/Product Owners on requirements, workflows, and designs for new features, providing input as features move toward build and testing. Establish technical standards and ensure scalable, modular solutions that can flex with product expansion.

Stakeholder Engagement and Thought Leadership

Build and maintain strong relationships with collaborators. Work closely with data and analytics teams to define and track in-market KPIs, asking the right questions of the data to uncover opportunities for improvement.
